item.title: Ray Marching
item.description: Explanation Ray marching is a rendering technique which sends rays out from the camera, and marches each ray forwards until the ray is close enough to an object in the scene. The 3D scene is defined using a function which returns the minimum distance from the closest object to a given 3D point. This is called the signed distance function. You can find lots of signed distance functions for simple 3D shapes the website made by Inigo Quilez.

item.title: L Systems
item.description: Explanation L systems carry out simple character to string replacements. You begin with a string (called the axiom) and then loop though each character in the string. Each character is then replaced by a string based on some rules. This process is repeated however many times you would like, usually called the number of iterations or the depth.
